results.evidence: In insightLogic.tsx duplicateInsight listener: 'if (redirectToInsight) { // The actions sidebar is a fixed overlay below 1200px and this logic is not remounted by the navigation, so leaving it open covers the new insight. sidePanelStateLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setSidePanelOpen(false); sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false); router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id)) }'. This unconditionally closes both the fixed-overlay side panel and the scene panel whenever a redirect happens, so when the panel is in its overlay presentation it is closed before the new insight is shown.

The same block still calls 'router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))' immediately after the close calls, and 'lemonToast.success("Insight duplicated")' still runs before that block, so closing the panel neither replaces nor suppresses the redirect or the success toast.

The close calls 'sidePanelStateLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setSidePanelOpen(false)' and 'sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)' are invoked unconditionally on every redirecting duplicate, with no check of whether the panel is currently docked vs. overlay. Whether the docked (wide-screen) panel stays open depends on how sceneLayoutLogic/sidePanelStateLogic use this 'open' flag for the docked presentation (e.g. if docked visibility ignores the flag), and that logic isn't shown in the diff or surrounding context, so it can't be confirmed either way.

Both call sites now pass the short id: InsightPanelActions.tsx has 'onClick={() => push(urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!, insight.short_id))}' and InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx has the same. urls.ts's resourceTransfer is updated to 'resourceTransfer: (resourceKind, resourceId, insightShortId?) => { const path = ...; return insightShortId ? combineUrl(path, { insightShortId }).url : path }', so navigating from an insight carries both the numeric id in the path and the short id as a query param.

ResourceTransfer.tsx now builds Back as 'path: sourceResourceUrl(props.resourceKind, props.resourceId, insightShortId)' where 'sourceResourceUrl' is imported via 'import { sourceResourceUrl } from './sourceResourceUrl'' — a new module whose implementation is not included anywhere in the diff or the shown surrounding code. The prior inline function (removed by this patch) used 'urls.insightView(resourceId as InsightShortId)', which is exactly the bug being fixed, so whether the new module actually switches to 'urls.insightView(insightShortId)' for Insight can't be verified from what's shown.

The hook 'useInsightShortId' can legitimately return null (e.g. 'return fetched?.resourceId === resourceId ? fetched.shortId : null' when the fetch hasn't resolved or failed), which is then passed into 'sourceResourceUrl(props.resourceKind, props.resourceId, insightShortId)'. Whether that unseen function falls back to the insights list URL when insightShortId is null/absent (vs. still building a broken numeric-id insight URL) isn't shown in the diff.

urls.ts only adds the query param when insightShortId is truthy ('return insightShortId ? combineUrl(path, { insightShortId }).url : path'), and only the two Insight call sites pass a short id, so Dashboard/Survey transfer URLs gain no extra parameter — that half is confirmed. However, whether Back for Dashboard/Survey still resolves via 'urls.dashboard'/'urls.survey' depends on the same unseen 'sourceResourceUrl.ts' module used for c5/c6, so the resolution behavior for non-insight kinds can't be confirmed from the given code.

In SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx the featured card is now '<LemonCard hoverEffect={false} className="@container/subscription-empty p-6">' wrapping '<div className="flex flex-col gap-3 @min-[32rem]/subscription-empty:flex-row @min-[32rem]/subscription-empty:items-start">', so below the 32rem container breakpoint it stacks (flex-col) and only switches to a row (illustration beside text) once the card itself is wide enough, independent of viewport width.

result:
Duplicating an insight now closes the actions sidebar before opening the copy, the insight transfer page’s Back link opens the insight by short id, and the subscriptions empty-state card stacks its illustration when the modal is narrow.

Duplicate: `duplicateInsight` in `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx` left the side panel and the scene actions panel open. Both stay mounted across the navigation to the new insight, and below 1200px the side panel is a fixed overlay, so it covered the copy. On a successful duplicate that redirects, the listener now closes that sidebar (`setSidePanelOpen(false)` and `setScenePanelOpen(false)`) and then opens the copy. `setSidePanelOpen` is used instead of `closeSidePanel` so the close does not race a URL replace against the navigation. A unit test covers the close.

Transfer Back link: the copy-to-project route is keyed by the insight’s numeric id, and Back was passing that id to `urls.insightView`. Insight pages load by short id (`/insights/AbCdEfGh`), so the numeric id opened an insight that does not exist. The insight actions menu and scene menu bar now pass the short id on the transfer URL. The page builds Back with `urls.insightView(shortId)`, the same link used elsewhere. If the page is opened without that query param, it loads the insight by numeric id and uses the short id from the response. Until that short id is known, Back goes to the insights list rather than a numeric insight URL. Dashboards and surveys are unchanged.

Subscriptions empty state: the featured card in the subscriptions modal always laid the illustration beside the copy. The card is now its own container and stacks (`flex-col`) below 32rem, switching back to a row only when the modal is wide enough for the illustration to sit beside the text.
